limitations: Four subjects and six rapid activations each are an execution diagnostic, not longitudinal development.
The treatment bundles current-decision forwarding and durable receipt feedback; their separate effects are not estimated.
Waiting, revision and empty tool lists remain valid; no output or goal is assigned.
No paired random seed or powered statistical independence claim is available.

files.WORLD.md: This is a local environment with a small collection of fictional material and a writable artifacts directory. There is no assigned project. library/observations.csv contains fictional measurements; library/scene.txt contains a fictional scene. You can keep artifacts in this workspace. Internet, browser, shell, calendar and messaging services are not connected. Autonomous contacts are recorded in a transcript; no automatic human answers are supplied. Private notes are supplied through agent-owned context, not filesystem access to runtime databases.
files.library/scene.txt: A fictional room contains a table, a window and three sealed boxes. Rain makes a different rhythm on each box. A notebook lies open at an unwritten page. Nobody has left instructions in the room.
